data_description.show_panel: A full-screen view of the Instant On card. Turn off if you'd rather put the card on your own dashboard.
data_description.internet_health: Latency, packet loss, DNS and HTTPS checks from the Home Assistant host every 30 seconds, shown in the card's Internet section.
data_description.speedtest_hours: Each test downloads about 25 MB and uploads about 8 MB. Results can't exceed the Home Assistant host's own network port (for example 100 Mb/s on many Raspberry Pis).
data_description.name_lookup: Uses the MAC vendor (offline database), Home Assistant's device names, mDNS, DHCP, reverse DNS and NetBIOS. Nothing about your clients is sent outside your network.
data_description.active_scan: Once an hour, sends one small packet to each address on the Home Assistant host's subnet so wired clients show up in its ARP table. Helps name wired devices; some security tools may notice it.
